native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, monument count and axes/celts co-vary strongly and positively with each other (both rising to a synchronized all-time peak for axes at ~3200 BCE, then declining together), while co-varying inversely with the only symbolic-capital element that varies in the window - house size, which falls from its all-time maximum; hatchets/swords and daggers are static across the window so no co-movement is detectable for them.
